title: IBM Power Systems Firmware FW1060.00 through FW1060.81 could allow a remote attacker to cause a… (CVE-2026-17426)
description: IBM Power Systems Firmware versions FW1060.00 through FW1060.81 contain a vulnerability that could allow a remote attacker to cause a denial of service by triggering an unhandled exception. This issue affects the availability of the system but does not impact confidentiality or integrity.
